messages:
Maya (partnerships): Heads-up — OrcaCloud + ZenithSys want to ship a joint Bali region (bali-southeast2) next month. Need capacity quotas, KMS flow, and a short joint announcement plan. Can we map owners?
Lars (eng): Thanks — are we targeting dedicated GPUs or marketplace SKUs for initial launch?
Diego (OrcaCloud PM): We planned to offer both: marketplace first (presto SKUs), then dedicated pools for enterprise customers. Marketplace quotas are priority.
Priya (partner-eng): For marketplace SKUs I need the exact SKU names + expected QPS. Diego, can you drop expected peak qps and token estimates?
Diego (OrcaCloud PM): Expected peak 600 qps from pilot, ~2.5M tokens/day. SKUs: oc-presto-x1, oc-presto-x2. Will confirm by EOD.
Jun (sales): Also flagging APAC reseller deals — if dedicated is delayed we should still be able to route paid customers to marketplace. Need SLA language for partners.
Zoe (ZenithSys): ZenithSys will provide the infra integration and install agents in customers' VPCs. We need the private deployment onboarding docs + a sample terraform module.
Maya (partnerships): Action items: (1) Priya to validate SKU compatibility with runtime, (2) Theo to reserve quota with cloud partner, (3) Amir to validate KMS/legal for joint PR, (4) Jun & Diego to draft joint announcement outline.
Priya (partner-eng): I ran a quick compatibility check: oc-presto-x1 quantizes fine but oc-presto-x2 is a newer arch — I need a small test model run. Can we queue a test job?
Theo (sre): I'll submit a quota request to the marketplace partner. ETA 48–72h. Need exact SKU IDs and entitlements. Will post the request link when created.
Amir (legal): For the announcement we need: (a) partner logos with signed usage, (b) joint statement sign-off, (c) any local compliance disclaimers for Indonesia. Please route assets to legal@redwood.com.
Lars (eng): Priya — if oc-presto-x2 needs kernel fallback, we should set a canary rollout with automatic fallback to x1. I can add a rollout policy in the config.
deploy-bot: New run created: quota-request/bali-southeast2 by Theo — https://deploy.redwood.internal/req/78834 (status: pending)
Maya (partnerships): Diego/Zoe — can you confirm a preferred target date for public announcement? We should align legal + press coms.
Diego (OrcaCloud PM): Prefer week of Apr 11th. That gives partners ~3 weeks to finish integration.
Zoe (ZenithSys): Apr 11 works for Zenith — final docs and terraform module by Apr 4? We'll need a short testing window.
Jun (sales): Suggest soft launch for beta customers Apr 4, then public Apr 11. Keeps sales pipeline happy.
Priya (partner-eng): Test job request: job: bali-prescan-1, model: tiny-serve-test, sequence: 512, owner: Priya. Please approve queueing.
Theo (sre): Approved — queued job id: q-55921. Will share logs in this thread when complete.
Amir (legal): Also confirm whether customer data will transit OrcaCloud-managed key material. If yes, need KMS MOU and attestation.
Diego (OrcaCloud PM): Data stays in customer VPC for private deploys; marketplace option uses Orca-managed keys initially. We'll prepare KMS MOU draft by Tue.
Lars (eng): If marketplace uses Orca KMS we need an integration test for key rotation. Priya, can you add that to the test matrix?
Priya (partner-eng): Done — added key rotation and decryption smoke to bali-prescan-1.
Maya (partnerships): Great. I'll consolidate owners and send a short kickoff doc. Quick checklist to confirm: SKUs + qps (Diego), quota ticket (Theo), KMS MOU (Diego/Amir), terraform + docs (Zoe), canary rollout config (Lars), test run results (Priya).
Diego (OrcaCloud PM): Will post SKU sheet + PR draft by EOD.
Theo (sre): Quota request created: https://deploy.redwood.internal/req/78834 — assigned to partner-ops.
Priya (partner-eng): Test job finished: q-55921 — success, 95th pct latency 48ms, key rotation smoke passed once. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/bali-prescan-1/logs
Maya (partnerships): Love it. Next sync Wed 09:30 PT — I'll send calendar. :spiral_calendar_pad:
Jun (sales): Noted. I'll prep a partner-facing one-pager for GTM.
Amir (legal): I'll review the PR copy and logos once Diego shares. Expect feedback within 48h.
Zoe (ZenithSys): Terraform module initial branch: https://git.internal/zenith/bali-terraform — open for review.
Lars (eng): I'll add the canary rollout policy and a fallback mapping to oc-presto-x1 in config repo — PR incoming.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks team — ping me if blockers.
Diego (OrcaCloud PM): Thanks all — will follow up with assets. :thumbsup:
